notes:
Venture 0.24 — mission names without spaces

• Mission names now keep to letters, numbers and underscores. A space or punctuation typed into a name turns into "_" as you type, so the name on screen is exactly the one the aircraft files its data under. Folders and photos named with spaces were breaking post-processing, which cut photo IDs off at the space.

• A plan can no longer be saved or renamed to a name another plan already has — including one that differs only by a space or a symbol, such as "Field A" and "Field_A". SAVE greys out and the page says which name is taken.

• Uploading under the time twice in the same minute no longer makes two missions with the same name: the second gets the seconds added.

• Plans you already have keep their names. They are cleaned up as they are uploaded, and their flights still file under them.

• Update the controller before the aircraft's core. Flying is not affected either way, but an older controller talking to an updated core can stop filing interrupted flights under plans whose names contain symbols.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings.
